summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Turkish Prayer Times App completed successfully. Tested all major features including live countdown timer, prayer times grid, city selection, theme toggle, 30-day schedule modal, Ramadan progress bar, mobile responsiveness, PWA functionality, and API integration with Aladhan service.

console_warnings.issue: HTML structure warnings in React DevTools - span inside tbody and tr inside span
console_warnings.impact: No functional impact, but creates console warnings

console_warnings.issue: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent accessibility

passed_tests: Page loads successfully with loading state
Live countdown timer updates every second correctly
All 6 prayer times displayed with correct Turkish names (İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı)
Akşam (Iftar) prayer card is properly highlighted with ring and glow effect
City selector dropdown works - successfully changed from default to Ankara and Istanbul
Theme toggle switches between light and dark mode correctly
30-day schedule modal opens and displays monthly prayer times with 28 rows of data
Ramadan progress bar displays correctly (Ramazan'ın 3. günü — %10)
URL parameter support works (?city=istanbul changes city selection)
LocalStorage saves city and theme preferences
Aladhan API integration works - all prayer times load successfully
PWA functionality: Service Worker registered, Manifest loads, Installation capability detected
Proper meta tags for viewport and theme color
No critical errors in console, app functions smoothly
action_item_for_main_agent: Consider fixing minor HTML structure warnings in the 30-day schedule modal table rendering and adding aria-describedby for better accessibility compliance. These are low priority cosmetic issues that don't affect functionality.
